thread:
maria: quick question — when I save a query from the Route view, should the saved query remember the exact model + variant I had selected, or should it always point to the route's current model (i.e. follow latest)? worried about regressions during rollouts.

jake: good callout. UX-wise we need both options. default might be follow-latest for most users, but teams doing controlled rollouts will want a 'pin to version' option. also want telemetry tied to each saved-query so regressions surface.

sophia: engineering note: pinning to a model version requires storing model_id + model_version in the saved query + routing fallback rules. if pinned model gets decommissioned we need an automatic compatible-variant fallback. otherwise requests will 404 or blow quota.

ravi: UI idea: in the save modal add a "scope" dropdown: [Route only] [Route + Model] [Global]. If Route+Model selected show a small checkbox "Pin to current model version". saved query list shows a badge: "pinned" or "follows latest".

li: frontend question — can we show estimated cost/latency at save time? we already have token estimates per model, but it would help if saved query card had a quick "cost per run" and "p50 latency" using model profile.

olivia: backend: agreed cost hints are useful. from routing POV: pinned queries should be routed by model_ref first, then if unavailable use a fallback policy that maps to compatible variants by quantization/arch. also need to respect Dedicated vs Hosted routing tiers.

rollout-bot: deploy: model kg-llama-x v2.1 rolled out to staging at 3123456820 :rocket:

sophia: pseudocode for fallback handling (very rough):
```
if saved_query.model_ref:
  try route_to(saved_query.model_ref)
  except Unavailable:
    try route_to(find_compatible_variant(saved_query.model_ref))
    except Unavailable:
      route_to(route.default_model)
else:
  route_to(route.current_model)
```

jake: proposal: default behavior = follow-latest (lowest surprise). add explicit "Pin to version" toggle in the save flow. surface per-saved-query telemetry: sample quality (BLEU/embedding-drift/etc), cost per-run, and optional regression alerts. for enterprise seats allow locking saved queries to model versions + audit entry.

maria: ok can we also add a quick "pin to current" action on the saved query card so you can flip an existing saved-query from following -> pinned without re-saving?

ravi: yes — will add a three-dot menu action: "Pin to current version" + a small confirmation modal explaining fallback semantics. microcopy will mention quota and cost impact.

olivia: one more backend thing: pinned heavy queries can accidentally exhaust Dedicated pools. propose a saved_query.quota_override field (optional) and server-side check that warns if pinned query's estimated qps > route's reserved capacity.

li: API contract we'll expose: saved_query = {
  "id": "...",
  "route_id": "...",
  "scope": "route|route+model|global",
  "model_ref": "kg-llama-x@v2.1" (optional),
  "quota_override": "optional string/number",
  "notify_on_regression": true
}

jake: next steps: sophia + olivia to prototype routing + fallback rules, li + ravi to mock UI and the saved-query card states, and I'll draft telemetry/alert fields. we'll bring this to weekly product sync.

maria: perfect — thanks all :thumbsup:
